title: Workspace sharing grants exactly the role given and revokes at once
description: Owners share a workspace by username; roles gate each action; the device owner stays an Owner; removing a member cancels their running sessions, voids their agent tokens and closes their event streams; invites carry a workspace role only for a workspace the admin owns.
preconditions: Go dependencies are present in the module cache.

assertions.target: sharing, role changes, removal and invites
